text:
maya: Quick question re: design partner incentives + scope negotiation for the private deploy beta. Want to avoid scope creep but still make it worth partners' time. Ideas? :seedling:

alex: Two-tier incentive works well: small stipend for participation + engineering credits if they hit onboarding milestones. Example: $500 + $2k infra credit on Dedicated.

chi: Agree. Also require a single point of contact and a 3-hour total time commitment cap (onboarding + interviews + feedback). Keeps asks reasonable.

ravi: On scope, we should clearly state which customizations we won't support: no custom quant permutations, no private kernel changes, and no infra swaps. We can offer parameter overrides within safe bounds (batch size, temp).

sara: Can we add a clause for "bug prioritization"? Partners often expect fixes to land fast. Proposal: bugs classified as P0/P1 get triage within 48h but not guaranteed SLA. That sets expectation.

maya: Good call. Also need data-sharing opt-in language. Minimal: partners agree to share redacted request/response samples + perf traces for diagnostics. Full logs optional.

alex: Draft invite blurb suggestion: 
```
Weinvite you to a 2-week private-deploy beta. You'll receive $500 + $2k infra credit. Participation requires a single POC, up to 3 hours total, and opt-in to share redacted logs and perf traces. We cannot support custom quantization or kernel changes during the beta.
```

chi: Love the blurb. Add: "participants will receive early access to rollout controls and a post-beta summary with performance tuning tips." That helps ROI messaging.

ravi: Measurement plan: partners run 5 canonical prompts, capture throughput/latency on our test harness, and complete a 6-question feedback form. Aim: 70% completion rate.

sara: Success criteria we should commit to before invites: 1) Onboard 6 partners, 2) avg 99th-pctl latency <= 300ms on Dedicated, 3) two improvement action-items implemented post-beta.

maya: Action list: Alex -> draft final invite + legal small-print, Chi -> confirm POC process + 3-hour cap in doc, Ravi -> create eval harness + prompts, Sara -> define bug triage wording. Ops-bot: please check send quota.

ops-bot: Reminder: bulk invite sends limited to 400/hr; schedule sends accordingly. :robot_face:

alex: I'll post draft by tomorrow noon for review in #product-review. Thanks all!
